title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-rpj4: error message references raw items[1] instead of validated suite variable in edhoc.py
description:
In `EdhocResponder.process_message_1` (python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py:593), `suite` is validated via `_validate_int(items[1], "suite")` on line 591, but the error message on line 593 still references raw `items[1]`:
```python
raise ValueError(f"Unsupported cipher suite: {items[1]}")
```
Should use `{suite}` instead of `{items[1]}` for consistency and to eliminate the correctness hazard if `_validate_int` semantics ever change.
